name: Route 66 Smokehouse

verifiedBusinessInfo.address: 79 Pearl Street, New York, NY 10004 (second entrance at 46 Stone Street; between Coenties Slip and Hanover Square)
verifiedBusinessInfo.hours: conflicting across sources (Stone Street district page: Mon-Wed 12pm-12am, Thu-Sat 12pm-2am, Sun 12pm-12am, kitchen closes 11pm; Yelp/others differ) - not shown; site says call ahead
verifiedBusinessInfo.other: Bourbon, brew and barbecue on Stone Street; Texas-style brisket and St. Louis ribs plus Southern riffs such as fried quail and waffles (Time Out); menu items per Yelp/blogs: sliced brisket, brisket sandwich, brisket sliders, beef ribs, pulled pork, smoked chicken; meats smoked in a basement pit (Glenwood); three spaces: year-round outdoor beer garden, indoor dining room, upstairs game room and lounge; bookable rooms listed on Tagvenue: 66 Lounge, Bar Cove, The Corner Cabana, Upstairs Game Room & Lounge, Outdoor Beer Garden; patio hosts 100+ guests.

designDirection: A night-highway roadhouse for a FiDi after-work crowd: Big Shoulders Display (tall industrial condensed) with Barlow body and IBM Plex Mono mile-marker labels, on asphalt black, sodium-lamp orange, shield cream, centerline yellow, exit-sign green and brick red. The hero is a full-bleed overhead barbecue tray with a dark directional shade, mile-marker tags and a stacked poster headline, while an animated dashed yellow road centerline runs down the right edge. Sections read as a drive: a black felt letterboard 'pit list' beside a ribs photo, three green highway exit signs for the beer garden / dining room / upstairs game room, a sodium-orange events band, and a 'Destination' exit sign with big map/call rows. The events page lists the five bookable rooms with outlined numerals. Mobile adds a sticky Call / Directions bar. Primary CTA: call.
